name: pumi-nudge
description: A notification from the OS when an agent is blocked or done, so a long turn does not need the window watched.

blocked.label: Waiting agents
blocked.desc: Say so when an agent stops to wait for you: a permission, a question, a plan to approve.

done.label: Finished turns
done.desc: Say so when an agent finishes a turn and its result is waiting for you.

error.label: Failed agents
error.desc: Say so when an agent fails (its state is `error`).

sound.label: Sound
sound.desc: The sound the notice makes: `default` for the system's, a sound's name, or empty for a silent one.
